Overview.Name: Kankara Greeshmasree Reddy
Overview.Goal: Achieve visible fat loss, improve body shape, feel energetic and confident, and support long-term health through simple, structured meals.

Meal_1_Breakfast: OR Omelette with onions and tomatoes
Meal_2_Lunch: Chicken curry + 1 cup rice + cooked vegetables
OR Fish pan fried + rice + vegetable sabzi
OR Chicken pan fried + vegetable plate
Meal_3_Dinner: OR Fish curry + small rice + vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Since sweets and fried foods trigger overeating, avoid keeping them at home.
Base every meal around eggs, chicken, or fish to control hunger and support fat loss.
For irregular work hours, keep boiled eggs or cooked chicken ready for quick meals.
If stress or late nights trigger cravings, eat protein first before deciding on anything else.
During social outings, choose grilled or pan-fried non-veg and skip fried starters.
Start yoga consistently to improve metabolism and body tone.
Aim to slowly increase steps toward 7,000 per day for better fat loss results.
Drink enough water through the day to reduce false hunger and sugar cravings.
